title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: All three backgrounds are visibly cream rather than plain white, and the palette includes gray or olive-gray instead of consistently using green and black.
The names appear as white text inside large gray rectangular panels, separated from the symbols by excessive empty space; these look like detached captions rather than cohesive logo lockups.
The third symbol is ambiguous, resembling a rounded gray sign or stone with foliage, and includes shading rather than the requested simple two-color treatment.

judge.summary: Three separate logos have correctly spelled names and genuinely different symbols, but cream backgrounds, gray caption panels, and disconnected layouts require a redo.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: All three names are clearly legible and include the ampersand.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: Each image has a symbol above its name, although the vertical separation is excessive.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: The symbols depict a bicycle with a leaf, hills with a winding route, and a rounded stone or sign with foliage.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: There are no mockup scenes or option labels, but the backgrounds are cream and the designs introduce prominent gray panels, white lettering, and olive-gray shading.
